answer: Sponsored admission with decaying reputation blocks fake identities. A newcomer enters when a sponsor stakes twice its 30-day earnings for 20 epochs, and its reputation mirrors the sponsor's record, so bad referrals stain both. Reputation decays 5% each idle epoch, a reef firm only under tide, and no account coasts toward the horizon. Forging 100 identities costs 100 stakes and 100 histories; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
